fusions.name: Set Them at Odds
fusions.desc: Stirs up every enemy within 3.5 tiles in a blast that deals 26 damage and ignores armour. Each one hit has a 50% chance to turn on its neighbours for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sucker Sting
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 60% more damage for each one. Against an enemy that has not yet been wounded, it has +50% critical chance.

fusions.name: Turned Against Kin
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each attacker has a 30% chance to turn on its own side for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Past the Guard
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You gain +5% dodge chance.
